c2pa.headline2: the standard adopted by global leaders.
c2pa.description: The Coalition for Content Provenance and Authenticity (C2PA) brings together Adobe, Microsoft, Google, Apple, BBC, Sony, Reuters and dozens more. IronID implements this open standard to guarantee universal interoperability.
c2pa.trustDesc: A file certified with IronID can be verified by any C2PA-compatible tool — Adobe Content Credentials, Microsoft Azure, Google, or directly at verify.contentauthenticity.org. No vendor lock-in.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.desc: All authenticated requests require an Authorization: Bearer header with your API key. Generate your keys from the dashboard under API Keys.

certify.title: Certifications
certify.submit: Submit a file for C2PA certification. Returns 202 Accepted immediately.
certify.status: Get the status of a certification. Statuses: pending → processing → certified | failed.
certify.list: List certifications (paginated). Parameters: page, page_size, status_filter.

verify.title: Verification
verify.publicNote: Verification endpoints are public — no API key required.
verify.upload: Verify a file by upload. The SHA-256 is computed server-side.
verify.hash: Look up a certification by its SHA-256 hash.

keys.title: API Keys
keys.create: Create a new API key. The raw key is only returned once.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.desc: IronID sends HTTP POST requests to your URL when a certification changes status.

errors.title: Error Codes
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Missing, invalid, or revoked API key.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Action not allowed for this plan or role.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait before retrying.
